description: Searches the library for skills, MCP servers, prompts, or repos by keyword. Returns only items that passed the security scan, each with install command, license, source, and a page link. Results are catalog data and do not include user comments.

category.description: Optional library section slug. Allowed values are the library category slugs.

query.description: Search keywords, for example 'cold email' or 'scraping'. An empty or omitted value lists top items.

name: search_library
title: Search the Upskill library
